title: Batch Normalisation with nn.BatchNorm1d
learning_objectives: Explain how BatchNorm1d uses batch statistics in training and running statistics in evaluation
Compute the running mean and variance updates with momentum
Recognise the biased and unbiased variances BatchNorm uses
hints: Convert each batch with `torch.as_tensor(b, dtype=torch.float32)` and check its row count.
`bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(n_features, momentum=momentum)`; `bn.train()` and pass the batches; then `bn.eval()`.
Read `bn.running_mean.tolist()` and `bn.running_var.tolist()` after the training batches.

failure_feedback.advice: Pass the batches in training mode with momentum=momentum; running_var uses the unbiased variance.
Return the output of the last training batch.
Reject an empty list and batches with fewer than two rows.
